title: Restaurant Menu Scraper
description: Provide the restaurants to look up. For each one the Actor checks delivery partners first and falls back to the Google Maps menu.

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.description: List of restaurants. Each entry is either a string (a restaurant name or a Google Maps URL) or an object with: name, address, city, country (ISO code), googleMapsUrl, latitude, longitude. A Google Maps URL (including maps.app.goo.gl short links) is the most reliable input because it carries exact coordinates.

country.title: Default country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
country.description: Used for restaurants that don't set their own country. Foodpanda is region-specific, so this selects the regional API (supported: PK, BD, SG, MY, PH, TH, HK, TW, KH, LA, MM).

partners.title: Delivery partners to check
partners.description: Partners are always tried in this order: Foodpanda, then Uber Eats. The first partner with a matching restaurant wins.

googleMapsFallback.title: Fall back to Google Maps menu
googleMapsFallback.description: When no delivery partner has the restaurant, open its Google Maps place page and extract the Menu tab.

gmapsSessions.title: Google sessions (cookies)
gmapsSessions.description: Logged-in Google sessions used by the Google Maps fallback. Array of objects: { "id": "account-1", "cookies": [ ...cookie objects exported as JSON from a browser where you are signed in to an account you own... ] }. Several sessions are rotated, and sessions that hit a login wall are rested automatically. Stored as a secret.

matchThreshold.title: Match threshold (0-100)
matchThreshold.description: Minimum fuzzy-match score between the restaurant you asked for and a partner listing.

maxDistanceMeters.title: Max distance to partner listing (meters)
maxDistanceMeters.description: A partner listing farther than this from the restaurant's coordinates is rejected (stops chain restaurants matching the wrong branch). Automatically relaxed when coordinates were only geocoded approximately.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent restaurants
maxConcurrency.description: How many restaurants are processed in parallel.

maxGoogleMapsConcurrency.title: Max concurrent Google Maps pages
maxGoogleMapsConcurrency.description: Browser pages opened in parallel for the Google Maps fallback. Keep this low to protect your sessions.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended: delivery platforms and Google both block datacenter IPs aggressively.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Saves screenshots and page text of the Google Maps flow to the key-value store so selectors can be tuned.
